description: Installs Agent Skills, folders holding a SKILL.md, from GitHub repositories, plugin marketplaces, and local folders into RubyLLM's app/skills and the folders Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other agents read. author: Nathan Kidd
description: hey sends load to a web application and reports a latency histogram, percentile distribution and per-phase timings. A file-by-file Ruby port of rakyll/hey: goroutines and channels become Async tasks and queues, and net/http becomes async-http. The gem is named hey.rb because hey was taken.
